plugins.Author: erdelf, Herculezz
plugins.Name: AutoDuty
plugins.Punchline: Dungeons while you sleep, eat, or work. (Swimsuit Shtola made easy.)
plugins.Description: A plugin to run dungeons for you with Trust, Duty Support, Squadrons, Variants, and Regular, Requires BossMod, vnavmesh and a Rotation Plugin (BossMod AutoRotation, Wrath or RotationSolverReborn)
